## Why visit

A priority for this trip because cider is given the same serious attention as beer. The modest converted-shop exterior hides a substantial cellar and bottle offer, with a relaxed downstairs bar and more space upstairs. It supplies a useful contrast to Stockport’s Robinsons heritage pubs: independent beer selection, changing producers and genuine cider exploration. Ask to see the full cider and perry list, including bottles and cellar stock; the visible pumps are only part of the story. A particularly good place to compare different cider makers rather than simply order the house pour.

## Beer

CAMRA documents six changing cask beers, usually from regional independents, alongside keg and a bottle shop. Recent CAMRA cask sightings include Vocation Pride & Joy and RedWillow Breakfast Stout; they are changing guests, not guaranteed regulars.

**Real cider documented; reconfirm stock.** CAMRA explicitly records real cider/perry in the fridge and cellar and bottled selections; its September 2026 entry records 2026 regional cider recognition. Greater Manchester and North West cider honours were renewed in 2026.
